title: Brutal Drinks Blackcurrant Crush 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Brutal Drinks’ Blackcurrant Crush Nic Salt e-liquid delivers the rich and juicy taste of fresh Blackcurrant in every puff. Bursting with natural sweetness and deep berry notes, this flavour is perfect for vapers who enjoy bold and fruity profiles. Crafted by the experts at Just Juice, the Brutal Drinks Nic Salts range offers vibrant, drink-inspired flavours in a smooth nicotine salt format. Blackcurrant Crush features a 50VG/50PG blend, designed for Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) devices and pod kits, providing smooth throat hits and fast-absorbing nicotine satisfaction. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, this e-liquid is perfect for everyday use. Part of the Brutal Drinks collection, Blackcurrant Crush joins a vibrant line-up of drink-inspired flavours, including Mango Lassi, Frozen Mojito, and Brutal Bull. Discover the full range for more refreshing blends.
